The Heart of England Welcomed National Spotlight with
The Hotel Inspector

Coventry’s own Heart of England Conference and Events Centre recently stepped into the national spotlight, featuring in Episode 8 of Season 20 of Channel 5’s popular series The Hotel Inspector with Alex Polizzi. The episode focused on the property’s on-site accommodation, formerly known as Old Hall House, which after Alex’s expert guidance has been relaunched as Heart House.

The Heart of England has long been known locally as a versatile venue, offering everything from corporate events and weddings to family days out. But like many hospitality businesses, the accommodation side had faced challenges in standing out in a competitive market. The opportunity to work with The Hotel Inspector was both a nerve-wracking and exciting step, bringing with it an honest appraisal of the business, fresh ideas for improvement, and a national television audience.

Managing Director Stephen Hammon appeared on the show alongside his daughters Frankie and Georgie, making the experience a true family effort. Together, they worked with Alex Polizzi to take a fresh look at the accommodation and implement changes to help the business thrive.

WATCH THE SHOW

The transformation into Heart House has already begun to make its mark. With clearer branding, a stronger identity, and an improved guest experience, the team has seen a boost in bookings and occupancy since the episode aired. Guests are responding positively not only to the refurbished spaces but also to the renewed confidence and energy that the rebrand represents.

The programme also highlighted the importance of partnerships in hospitality. Experience gift company Wonderdays visited the property during filming, showing how collaborations can open doors to new audiences. With the popularity of “experience days” on the rise, this link offers opportunities for Heart House to attract customers looking for more than just a stay – but a memorable experience.

For the Heart of England team, the TV appearance has been more than a makeover; it has been a catalyst for growth, innovation, and renewed ambition. Being featured on a national platform has raised awareness of the venue well beyond Coventry, bringing in visitors who might otherwise never have discovered this hidden gem.

Stephen Hammon, Managing Director of Heart of England, said: “Appearing on The Hotel Inspector has been a real turning point for us. Heart House now has a strong identity, and we’re excited to welcome even more guests in the months ahead.”

DATES OF SHOWS 2023 – WEATHER PERMITTING

Solihull Cycling Club has been holding its annual cyclocross event at the Heart of England since 2014. This year we will hold a second event at this excellent outdoor venue. That event will be promoted by Dynamic Rides Cycling Club, which is based in Hockley Heath.

There are seven separate races throughout the day for age categories that range from Under-6 to Over-60. The racing is fast and furious, and exciting to watch. Many of today’s World cycling stars started out riding cyclocross, and some current GB professional riders have ridden at the Heart of England in the past.

Spectators are welcome. Parking is £3 per vehicle.

Background

  1. Cyclocross is a form of bicycle racing that takes place in the autumn and winter.
  2. Races consist of many laps of a short (1.5–2 mile) course featuring pavement, wooded trails, grass, steep hills and obstacles requiring the rider to quickly dismount, carry the bike while navigating the obstruction and remount.
  3. The sport is very popular in Belgium, France and the Netherlands, and is growing rapidly in the UK.
  4. The West Midlands Cyclocross League is open to riders from anywhere – they do not need to live in the West Midlands.
  5. The 2023 WMCCL season comprises 12 events, which can be entered here: https://www.riderhq.com/events?type=RACE_WMIDSCX

The West Midlands Cyclo-Cross League (WMCCL) offers competitive off-road bike racing for all ages and abilities. You don’t need any specialist equipment to start, as long as your bike is safe for yourself and others. Most events can be entered on the day, and you don’t need a British Cycling racing license to get started.

Cyclo-cross combines elements of road cycling and mountain biking. The races typically take place in the autumn and winter seasons, and consist of many laps of a short course featuring gravel tracks, wooded trails, grass, steep hills, and obstacles which sometimes require the rider to dismount and carry the bike. The courses are sometimes muddy and challenging, making it a fun sport to watch and participate in. 

If you’re interested in learning more about cyclo-cross, you can visit the British Cycling or WMCCL websites.

At The Heart of England Conference and Events Centre, we are lucky enough to host an incredible variety of events throughout the year. From corporate fun days and festivals to weddings, charity events, team-building days and private celebrations, every event brings its own story, energy and purpose.

But every so often, an event comes along that reminds us exactly why we do what we do.

The recent festival for pagans and witches was one of those events.

As Managing Director here at The Heart of England, I was genuinely delighted that we were able to support the organisers throughout the year and provide the setting for such a unique and meaningful festival. It was a pleasure to welcome such a passionate, creative and community-minded group of people to our venue, and even more rewarding to see the event go on to make such a positive difference.

The organisers have now confirmed that an incredible £36,000 profit from the festival has been distributed to charity.

That is a fantastic achievement, and everyone involved should feel extremely proud.

What makes this even more special is the range of charities and causes that have benefited. The money raised has been shared between organisations supporting animal rescue, women’s aid, youth empowerment, environmental projects and community initiatives.

The charities receiving a share of the profits include:

The Retreat Animal Rescue
West Mercia Women’s Aid
Florie’s Friends Rescue
Coventry Haven
Suki’s Canine Rescue
Little Hearts
Empowering Gwynedd’s Youth
The Sherbourne Valley Project
Wilders Waters Appeal
PeaceJam

For us, this is exactly what events should be about. Yes, they are about bringing people together, creating memorable experiences and making use of our wonderful 160-acre Warwickshire setting — but they can also be about something much bigger.

They can raise awareness. They can support important causes. They can create lasting impact long after the final visitor has left and the last marquee has come down.

That is why the phrase “Heart Has a Heart” feels so fitting.

We are proud to be called The Heart of England, but we are even prouder when our venue can play a small part in helping others. Supporting events that give back to the wider community is something we care deeply about, and this festival is a brilliant example of what can be achieved when organisers, visitors, stallholders, performers and venue teams all work together.

I would like to personally congratulate the festival organisers on such an outstanding result. Raising £36,000 is no small achievement, and distributing that money across so many worthwhile causes shows real generosity, commitment and community spirit.

I would also like to thank everyone who attended, supported, volunteered, performed, traded or helped bring the festival to life. Events like this do not happen by accident — they are the result of hard work, passion and belief.

From all of us at The Heart of England Conference and Events Centre, it was a pleasure to help, and we look forward to continuing to support events that bring people together for good reasons.

Because at the end of the day, The Heart of England is more than a venue.

It is a place where people gather, celebrate, connect and, sometimes, make a real difference.

Stephen Hammon
Managing Director
The Heart of England Conference and Events Centre

about us

We are a Conference and Events Centre based in Coventry, Warwickshire in the West Midlands.

We offer Conferences, Events, Team Building, Product Launches, Exhibitions, Fun Days, Festivals, Weddings, Parties, Proms, Christmas Parties.
In addition to our Conference Centre, we have onsite 4* accommodation with Old Hall House and glamping pods, restaurant and so much more.

WHO WE ARE

We are an experienced team with demonstrable creative talents and a track record of making events stand out with a wow factor to be truly memorable.

WHAT WE DO

Whether you’re looking for a different type of meeting venue, or space to run a team building activity, we have answers for all requirements. Because of this you can let your imagination run wild. We make company event dreams come true. Our company motto is Dream Big, Everything is Possible!

Our event managers, catering teams, and event hosts can ensure your corporate event runs without a hitch.

As we are privately owned and have a fully flexible approach, we can organise virtually any corporate function for you. Ranging from a conference, product launch, corporate fun day with a festival theme or team building to a secure small meeting, we can do it all.

We cater for conferences up to 650/700 people and corporate fun days for thousands.

To stir your creative juices, see what we do or contact us via our contact page.

OUR LOCATION

Our location affords easy accessibility and 160 acres of space. That includes lakes, woodland and park. And with modern and adaptable indoor meeting spaces too, we can accommodate most functions. Although our rural location may feel remote, it is only minutes from main road and rail networks. 8 minutes from the M6, M42 & A45 and less than 30 minutes from M1 & M40.
As a result you can enjoy all that the Warwickshire countryside has to offer but be on your way home within minutes.
We are located between Fillongley and Meriden. Meriden is the absolute geographical centre of England. This means most of the large centres of population are within about two hours travel time.

OPEN AIR WELLNESS

Welcome to Open Air Wellness at Heart of England!

We’re all about promoting health and wellbeing in the heart of the beautiful English countryside. Our mission is simple: to get you, your teams, and your families outside, breathing in the fresh air, and enjoying tailor-made event days designed for both Team Building and Family Fun.

But don’t worry, we’re not just about tree-hugging experiences (although you’re more than welcome to hug our trees if you fancy!). Our range of activities across our parkland, by the serene lake, and amidst the tranquil woodland are geared towards all levels of skill and ability, with plenty of options just for pure fun.

Why spend time with us?

In the Parkland:

  • Breathe in Fresh Air: Boost your digestion and work towards your weight loss goals with increased oxygen intake.
  • Improve Blood Pressure: Step into a less polluted environment and let the serenity of our lake help lower your blood pressure.
  • Boost Happiness: More oxygen means more serotonin, the happy hormone, leaving you feeling on top of the world.
  • Strengthen Immunity: Let the fresh air empower your white blood cells to fight off pesky germs and bacteria.
  • Cleanse Your Lungs: Take deep breaths and let your lungs thank you for releasing toxins into the crisp air.
  • Energize Your Mind: Oxygen is fuel for your brain, enhancing concentration and leaving you feeling sharp and revitalized.

By the Lake:

  • Experience Instant Peace: Water is the elixir of life, calming your mind and soothing your soul.
  • Biological Connection: Being near water triggers positive responses in our brains, promoting overall wellness.
  • Promote Relaxation: The sight and sound of water induce a flood of neurochemicals, encouraging relaxation.
  • Dive into Wellness: Immersing yourself in water can treat physical and mental ailments, enhancing your wellbeing.
  • Fun Water Activities: From paddleboarding to kayaking, our lake offers endless opportunities for team building and family fun.

In the Woodland for Wellbeing:

  • Therapeutic Landscapes: Surround yourself with nature for physical, social, and psychological wellness.
  • Embrace the Healing Power: Time in the woods reduces stress, boosts mood, and aids recovery from illness.
  • Harness the Benefits: Improve immunity, reduce blood pressure, and increase energy levels by spending time among trees.
  • Research-Backed Benefits: Studies prove that woodland environments tackle obesity, heart disease, and mental health issues.

Ready to join us? Explore our activities in the park, woods, and by the lake on our website, or reach out to our friendly team who will guide you through the perfect wellness experience tailored just for you.
